summary: This informational document deprecates any int domain names that the IETF designated for infrastructure and identifies them for removal from the int top-level domain. Implementations involving these domains are now deprecated. It also changes RFC 1528 and RFC 1706 to Historic.

eli5.summary: Some old internet names ending in int were set aside for internet plumbing. This document says stop using them and moves two old documents to the history shelf.

questions: why is the int domain no longer used for infrastructure
